competences.description: Attacks the enemy and decreases its Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance. While under the Thunderer state, the attack inflicts damage that increases according to your Defense, and attacks additionally with lower damage to enemies of the same attribute as the target.

Attacks all enemies to recover the HP by 30% of the inflicted damage, and decreases their Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance. While under the Thunderer state, the attack inflicts damage that increases according to your Defense and provokes all enemies for 2 turns.

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Revives with 30% HP when you're defeated and then falls under the Thunderer state for 3 turns. While under the Thunderer state, decreases the incoming damage from the enemy by 25% and increases your Attack Bar by 15% if you get attacked during the enemy's turn. If the incoming damage is less than 10% of your MAX HP, the duration of the Thunderer state increases by 1 turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If you get attacked during the enemy's turn

competences.description: Falls under the Thunderer state that enhances your skills for 3 turns and instantly gains another turn. While under the Thunderer state, your Defense increases by 100%. Once the Thunderer state ends, you become stunned for 1 turn. In addition, decreases the skill cooldown of [The Sea Thunderer] by 2 turns each when you are not under the Thunderer state.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: When you are not under the Thunderer state
